Mobile-first: design for small screens first, then enhance for larger screens.
Use flexible layouts: CSS Grid/Flexbox + media queries handle most responsiveness.
Prefer HTTPS everywhere; never submit passwords over HTTP.
Store session IDs in cookies with Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite when possible.
Progressive enhancement: make core content usable even if JavaScript fails.
Optimize performance: compress images, defer non-critical JS, and avoid layout shift.
Accessibility is UX: labels, focus states, contrast, and keyboard navigation matter.
Use clear feedback: inline validation + toasts reduce user confusion.
